task.name: Todo REST API with Express.js
task.description: Build a complete REST API for a todo list application.
task.prompt:
Create a complete REST API for a todo list application using Express.js and an in-memory store. Requirements:

1. Express.js server on port 3000
2. In-memory array store (no database)
3. CRUD endpoints:
   - GET /todos - list all todos (support ?completed=true/false filter)
   - GET /todos/:id - get single todo
   - POST /todos - create todo (validate: title required, string, 1-100 chars)
   - PUT /todos/:id - update todo (validate fields)
   - DELETE /todos/:id - delete todo
4. Each todo: { id, title, completed (bool, default false), createdAt, updatedAt }
5. Proper error handling with HTTP status codes (400, 404, 500)
6. Input validation on all write endpoints
7. CORS enabled for all origins
8. JSON request/response everywhere
9. Export the app (not just listen) for testability
10. Include a complete test file using supertest that covers all endpoints including error cases.

Output ONLY the complete source code with no explanation. Use modern JavaScript (ES2020+). Include proper error handling, input validation, and clean code structure.
